{{verse|chapter=10|verse=5}} The{{ls}}e tvvelue did {{sc|Iesvs}} {{ls}}end: commaunding them, {{ls}}aying, Into the vvay of the {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ They haue here commi{{ls}}{{ls}}ion to preach only in I{{ls}}rael: the time being not yet come to call the Gentiles.}}∷ Gentiles goe ye not, and into the cities of the Samaritans enter ye not: {{verse|chapter=10|verse=6}} but goe rather to the {{ls}}heepe that are peri{{ls}}hed of the hou{{ls}}e of I{{ls}}rael. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=7}} And going preache, {{ls}}aying, That the kingdom of heauē is at hand. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=8}} Cure the {{ls}}icke, rai{{ls}}e the dead, clean{{ls}}e the lepers, ca{{ls}}t out diuels: gratis you haue receiued, gratis giue ye. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=9}} Do not {{sup|‖}} po{{ls}}{{ls}}e{{ls}}{{ls}}e gold, nor {{ls}}iluer, nor money in your pur{{ls}}es: {{verse|chapter=10|verse=10}} not a {{ls}}krippe for the vvay, neither two coates, neither {{ls}}hoes, neither rodde. for the vvorkeman is vvorthie of his meate. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=11}} And into vvhat{{ls}}oeuer citie or tovvne you {{ls}}hal enter, inquire vvho in it is vvorthie: and there tarie til you goe forth. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=12}} And vvhen ye enter into the hou{{ls}}e, {{ls}}alute it, {{ls}}aying, {{sup|‖}} Peace be to this hou{{ls}}e. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=13}} And if {{ls}}o be that hou{{ls}}e be vvorthie, your peace {{ls}}hal come vpon it. but if it be not vvorthie: your peace {{ls}}hal returne to you. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=14}} And vvho{{ls}}oeuer {{ls}}hal not receiue you, nor heare your vvordes: going forth out of the hou{{ls}}e or the citie {{sup|‖}} {{ls}}hake of the du{{ls}}t from your feete. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=15}} Amen I {{ls}}ay to you, it {{ls}}hal be {{sup|‖}} more tolerable for the land of the Sodomites and Gomorrheans in the day of iudgement, then for that citie.
